The staff is very professional, friendly, and They make their furry friends feel welcomed. 🐾Their service is definitely top-tier and their prices are affordable. Definitely love the vibe and recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a pet grooming salon. 🐶

This is my go-to groomer for my fur baby! They always take amazing care and consideration for him and they ensure they finish the service and not like other groomers that will do an incomplete job. I've never had an issue at this location! I would personally recommend two amazing ladies that work there. Jessica, the main manager, demonstrates so much compassion in what she does. She ensures that your pet is well taken care of and she's easy to get along with. Another amazing lady is Amanda. Amanda is one of their groomers and she does a fantastic job with your pet. She does a thorough job, even going above and beyond with making sure your pet is groomed in a way that will make you leaving the location satisfied. I would recommend taking your pets here!
We love Graceful Pet! They always do an amazing job with our Frenchie, Coco. They are always flexible and take care of our every request. Highly recommend!
They always do such a good job with our Frenchie. We also love that they have a Frenchie Friday. My original review was about 2 years ago and I still feel the same way. 5 stars

I absolutely love to bring my dog over here. The staff are super friendly and the groomers are amazing at what they do. I trust my dog to any of the groomers they have and would definitely recommend people trying to find a new grooming shop to come over here.

Been going here for 6 years really good friendly staff.

Update:
The place has gotten better, more staffing and I'm grateful for their patience with my puppies!

I took my baby there a week ago she came back traumatized came back coughing like they choked her it's been a week and she's still not herself I might have to take her to the vet couldn't even sit cuz they're behind hurt please don't take your fur babies there.

I recently decided to switch groomers bc our previous groomer switched to an answering service and now I can’t get a hold of anyone let alone set up an appointment. So I asked around and was recommended to Graceful Pet Grooming. I was able to book online for an appointment within just a few days. My girl looked so cute when she came out of there. But also they were able to trim her nails which has always been an issue with other groomers. I feel like my baby has found a new salon lol. I am so excited about how she came out of there and I’m pretty sure my pup knew she looked good too. 😊 Koko is ready for Mardi Gras!

My baby Daisy got some pampering today thanks to the professional, gentle, & caring staff at Graceful Pet Grooming & we’re so pleased with their service. We’ve been bringing Daisy for several years & will continue to do so bc I won’t trust anyone else with my baby.

Sells false information about dog breeds so you end up buying unnecessary treatments that end up making things worse for your dog, so you have no choice but to come back and ask them to fix it. They only care about money, not you or your dog
They provided with an amazing service, not 100% satisfied with the haircut but will give it another chance and update my review!

The service was fantastic and they had my dog in and out in less than a hour, They took my dog whose legs have started getting weaker, when no one else would. The staff was great and they took great care of my dog. Would recommend and will definitely be returning.
Loveeee taking my puppy here🐶💞 …
My baby came out super cute, happy, and smelling amazing!! All the girls there are super sweet, i wont go anywhere else but GRACEFUL PET GROOMING💖 …
Love this place; before my Husky passed away, I always took my Husky to them because they knew exactly how to deal with him, and he loved it. Now I  take my new pet to them.

All 20 of my dogs nails were over clipped and bleeding, while the groomers explained to me that the dog doesn’t feel any pain from an over clipped nail, my dog showed very obvious signs of distress and pain. While she was an old girl she has since passed, but I would never bring my other 2 babies to Graceful Pet Grooming. I don’t like to write bad reviews especially for small businesses and hesitated to write this one, but for a groomer, I would think it’s basic knowledge to look for the quick before just cutting whatever. You could clearly see the quick in my dogs nails btw, and they clearly didn’t bother to look.
Always do a great job. Groomer with experience for large dogs too, takes cere of our 94lb doodle
They do an awesome job and they are a very  humble staff

I can’t say enough good things about graceful grooming. My dog is extremely anxious when it comes to grooming, and past experiences—especially at big chain groomers like PetSmart—have been stressful and disappointing. PetSmart groomers didn’t have the patience to work with our pup’s anxiety, which often left her even more nervous and uncomfortable.

That all changed when we found Graceful Grooming. From the moment we walked in, they took the time to make our pup feel safe and comfortable. They moved at her pace, reassured her throughout the process, and never forced her into anything she wasn’t ready for. It was such a relief to see a grooming team especially Jessica, that truly cares about the well-being of the animals they work with.

Not only did Jessica do an amazing job with the grooming itself, but they also made what used to be a traumatic experience into something much more positive. If you have an anxious or nervous pet, I highly recommend Graceful grooming . Jessica patience, kindness, and expertise make all the difference!

I continue to be impressed with Graceful Pet Grooming.   The reasons are they are very professional, they take very good care of our toy poodle Penny.   It’s a very clean facility and you can see them working on dogs when you enter the establishment.  The groomers are very sweet.   My dog doesn’t seem scared when I drop her off or when I pick her up and that’s a great feeling.

Ellie always leaves feeling confident and comfortable. It is easy to see that the groomers that work here ensure to treat their furry customers with care. They listen and work with you on how to make your fur baby look perfect so that they feel their best. ❤️

This was our first time here and the ladies were amazing! Great consultation. They asked lots of questions to make sure I was happy- this goes a loong way! I've never been happier with a grooming for my babies, and they came back pretty and happy too! Highly recommend and will be back!
My 5 month old kitten was groomed here and he’s been in such a sweet mood. Very friendly environment.

The BEST pet grooming around, My Maltipoo has been going to Graceful pets since moving to SA.  They take to heart my requests for Maisie.  Such lovely, professional staff.  Maisie loves seeing them when we go for her appointments and is well cared for while there.  I LOVE Graceful
Pets and highly, HIGHLY recommend!! Would give 10 stars if I could!
Jessica’s and Brenda did a great job on grooming my fur babies !!

Took my dog Max there to get groomed and ready for the holidays and Brenda did an AMAZING JOB. She took very good care of my pup and he came out happy and very handsome. Pics for reference! Will definitely be back as a regular :)

I can’t say enough great things about Graceful Grooming and Ms. Brenda! Every time I bring my pet in, I know she’s in the best hands. Ms. Brenda is not only incredibly skilled but also so kind and patient. My 100lb Great Pyrenees always comes back looking amazing and, more importantly, happy and stress-free.

The attention to detail and genuine care this place provides is unmatched. From the clean and welcoming space to the personalized service, it’s clear they truly love what they do. If you’re looking for a groomer who will treat your babies like family, this is the place to go! Highly recommend!

If zero stars was a rating that’s what I would have selected. My dogs nails were over trimmed and I was not informed about the issue upon arrival. Instead, I was reminded how bad my dog was and how many different groomers attempted to handle my dog. He had never been aggressive however they claimed he attempted to bite groomers. I completely understand that accidents happen, but an owner should always be made aware of any cut or accident that occurs to their pet. When I returned to the shop and showed Jessica pictures of blood all over my backseat due to an overly trimmed nail on my dogs paw her response was “oh yeah, we put medicine on it.” I then became more angry, realizing that they were aware of the cut applied something and never made it known to me. When I questioned her and said, “so you knew about the cut, you applied something without my consent and continued to hide the incident?”, she retracted what she had said and stated, “well it’s not really medicine and continued on to tell me that that did not hurt my dog and I did not have to take them to the vet that she would put something on him, bandage his paw and give me wipes to clean my car.” Never did I receive an apology instead, I received excuses and my worries were dismissed. She even asked the other employee to add to my pets profile that he had been cut and Mom was upset. I was still charged the full amount And again no apology was ever given to me for allowing my pet to leave the salon without informing the owner of the occurrence matter of fact when I walked into the shop, all they could do was complain about my pets behavior, which they had already done over the phone multiple times During our phone call. I asked them to not stress him out and just leave him as he was. I am beyond disappointed. And P.S according to many websites dogs do feel pain for an over clipped nail!!!
Great care by everyone for our daughter’s service dog! 🐕‍🦺 …
The office manager was so sweet and very helpful. She is super awesome I recommend this place to anyone with a furry friend!

Took my 5 month old labradoodle, Kodi, for his first grooming session. What a fantastic service, he came back looking even more handsome. First class facilities and Jessica and her team provide a first class service. Kodi thoroughly enjoyed his pampering session!!!!
